CIRCULAR

It has come to the notice of the Headquarters that permission to go abroad is being
granted at the level of Adll.CPFC/RPFC/OIC whereas only the of CPFC has been delegated
the powers to permit employees to go abroad on personal visit in terms of Item No. 20
amended vide officer order No. HRM-I/D-16(1)2006 dated 09/06/2006 delegation of Powers.
To ascertain the extent of exercise of such powers not delegated to officers other than
CPFC, are being exercised for grant of permission to go abroad in the last 5 years, the
information be submitted to the Headquarter in the following format by 15 Nov, 2013.

Name of the | Period of | Leave Period Country | Expenditure | Any
Officer/ visit initially for the | Visited Incurred complaint
Staff granted | leave on code of
granted extended conduct

| permission abroad

It is also clarified that the Adil. CPFC, have been delegated powers to issue NOC for
Passport only and not for allowing on official to go abroad. Therefore, this practice of grant of
permission to employees by field officers to go abroad should be stopped forthwith.
